requirement.summary: POS Interface - Request to enhance External Webhook for HQ On-Premises Server  (Dev2/2)
requirement.description:
Background：

The St. Regis Hotel is currently using the “SevenRooms” service, so our system needs to connect to SevenRooms. Our system connects to SevenRooms via an External Webhook, and it is required to use the HQ Cloud Server. However, the St. Regis Hotel’s current infrastructure does not use the HQ Cloud Server. They are using the HQ On-Premises Server and a Dummy Cloud Server instead. Our Externa Webhook does not support this setup.

Issue found:

The highlighted part in screenshot-1.png was missing in the setup page

Requirement：

- Deploy the External Webhook module on both the HQ On-Premises Server and the Dummy Cloud Server.

- The St. Regis Hotel be able to integrate with SevenRooms via the External Webhook, enabling bidirectional communication for event delivery and data exchange.

New Functions : [JIRA-67229] POS Interface - Request to enhance External Webhook for HQ On-Premises Server (Dev2/2)
Descriptions:
Current Behavior
External webhooks currently support Cloud HQ only. A client has requested support for SevenRooms, an external webhook vendor, on On-Premises HQ, which is not currently available.
Expected Behavior
On-Premises HQ can receive external webhooks
The External Webhook Management nav item is shown for On-Premises HQ
New workflow for external webhook (On-Premises)
Setup:
Make sure the environment is setup with Dummy Cloud HQ server and On-Premises HQ Server
Dummy Cloud HQ server
On-Premises HQ Server
Navigate to “API Management->External Webhook Management”
Check for the webhook rules for sevenrooms
Click view button to enter “View Detail” page to verify the webhook
API Bridge
Navigate to ‘API Portal->Advanced Control->Rules’
Find the Rules by matching the application name with application name set on hq’s webhook rule, for this case it’s DefaultApplication (Shiji ST Vendor (PF Testing)
Click ‘view’ button to enter the ‘View Detail’ page
You can find the Secret Key here for testing for webhook later
Build a testing request to simulate for a sevenrooms external webhook
url
{{baseUrl}}/api_portal/webhook/seven_rooms/v1/resv_update/{{secretKey}}
Request body

{

}
